outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative bright-field and ICG fluorescence photographs of lungs; it is not a quantitative plot of averaged data, so individual data points are not applicable.
The bar graph of ICG mean fluorescence intensity already overlays individual data points (blue and red dots) for each biological replicate (n=5 and n=3 mice) on top of the mean ± SD bars.

Panel C contains micrograph/histology images (H&E, ICG, RNAscope) and spatial expression heatmap-style plots (Cd68, Spp1) overlaid on tissue sections; these spatial heatmaps do not represent means with replicates and individual points are not meaningful here.
Panel D shows GSEA enrichment score line plots, which are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement since overlaying points on a line plot is not meaningful/readable.

Panel E is a bar chart of log2 fold-change values per gene derived from differential expression analysis (Seurat FindMarkers, Wilcoxon test across many spots/cells) comparing two spatial regions; it represents a computed statistic rather than a mean of a small number of biological replicates, so individual data points are not applicable in the way box/violin or replicate-based bar charts would require.

Panel F shows representative fluorescence and IHC images from lung sections (n=2 mice); these are representative micrographs/photographs, not quantitative average plots, so individual data points are not applicable.
